description: Experimental (or literature-DFT) cubic-phase band gaps Eg and conduction-band spin-orbit splittings Delta for CsBX3, used as inputs to the k.p universal g-factor relation (Theme A, A4). Provided by Cowork's literature survey in next_directive.md v2 (2026-05-23, sec.2.2).
provenance_note: These Eg values come from Cowork's literature survey (directive v2). The cited source papers (Stoumpos 2013 JACS; Lin 2018; Nat.Commun.2022 for Pb) are NOT yet in references/pdfs/ -> flagged for repo ingestion (Cowork task). Pb Delta is from Nestoklon arXiv:2305.10586 Table S2 (in repo). Sn/Ge Delta is computed as Delta = 3*lambda_B from the Kashikar 13-orbital SOC parameters (Kashikar arXiv:2101.08562 Eq.9: the R-point CB SO splitting equals 3*lambda), since direct literature Delta for Sn/Ge is unresolved (Cowork task #18).
uncertainty_note: Eg literature values carry phase/temperature spread (~0.05-0.1 eV). Sn/Ge Delta (from Kashikar 3*lambda) carries ~+/-20% uncertainty; g-factors are reported with this propagated as a range.
